# Update all dependencies
- The template was an outdated NPM project, let's update to latest for good hygiene.
- Apparently we'd go from Astro 4 to Astro 7. So high risk of breaking changes.
## Blocked By:
Should have all the features written up _before_ I update so that I can check for breaking changes.

# Write a blog? (Optional)
I'm embarking on more side projects than before in the age of AI, maybe describing that work would be useful.

# Add resume to website
Add a copy of my resume to the website to be available for downloading

# Replacing theming
- At minimum: do something more colorfull than black and white. 
- Perhaps I can do something that responds to the system's dark mode/light mode preference?
- The [example page](https://astrofy-template.netlify.app/) had a theme option in the top-right. Could I incorporate that into my portfolio design?

# Publish website
Create a GitHub Action which deploys the website to madministrator.github.io on merges to main following this guide: https://docs.astro.build/en/guides/deploy/github/

# Figure out the Robots.txt thing
- What do I need to change for the sitemap?

# Figure out the RSS feed
- Personally, I've never used an RSS feed
- Not sure how much value it brings to the website
- If not writing a blog, probably strip it out

# Update home page
_index.astro serves as the home page_

Fill out the landing page with something other than content from the CV

# Replace portfolio picture

Replace the default emplate photo with my caricature photo

# Add icons to the skills section (optional)
- Might require turning skills from a bulleted list to a skill card list
- Not all skills have an icon?
- May clash with the style of the rest of the CV page
- [open source icons](https://icon-sets.iconify.design/)
- Maybe the cards and the list should be two separate sections, where the cards serve as a highlight reel of specific tools and frameworks?

# Create SVG favicon for the website
- Something to replace the astro placeholder
- Something more modern than my current one

Write down what I've got for now, goal would be to add more later.

Put my name in there

I only have GitHub and LinkedIn

- Basically the resume portion of the website
